items.question: How long does it take to get a response?
items.answer: Our team typically responds to all inquiries within 24 business hours.

items.question: Can I contribute an article or recipe?
items.answer: Yes! We welcome guest contributors, nutritionists, and chefs. Please select 'Recipe Submission' or 'Content Suggestion' in the contact form.

items.question: Do you offer personalized diet advice?
items.answer: We provide evidence-based nutritional insights and food comparisons. For clinical diet plans, we recommend consulting a certified nutritionist or medical professional.

items.question: How can I report incorrect information?
items.answer: If you notice an error in any food nutrition profile or article, please email hello@healthyawareness.com or send us a message above.

items.question: Can I collaborate with Healthy Awareness?
items.answer: Absolutely! We partner with health brands, research institutions, and wellness advocates. Get in touch via our partnership option.
